name: Teachmate
summary: UK-oriented suite of 160 AI tools for teachers: slideshows, worksheets, open chat, a secure report writer and a “clone my tone” feature.
description: UK-oriented suite of 160 AI tools for teachers: slideshows, worksheets, open chat, a secure report writer and a “clone my tone” feature.

pricing.details: Free — free tools only (not the full 160-tool library), no payment card required. Pro 10 € paid monthly, cancel anytime — full tool library, content exports, unlimited Open Chat, unlimited slideshow and worksheet generations, Secure Report Writer, Clone my Tone, unlimited refinements, early access to new tools, CPD webinars, free Certified Educator course. Pro annual renews at 86 €/year (the normal annual price). Promo: official first-year offer 72 € upfront (6 €/month equivalent in year one) with code FIRSTYEAR at checkout. FIRSTYEAR is a promo, not the normal price; the regular annual rate is 86 €/year. Whole School plans from as little as 2 € per teacher, per month, pay by invoice or card. School plans include everything in Pro for all staff plus licence management, INSET, SSO, DPIA documentation, invoice payment, school logo and UK-based support. Official list prices converted at the ECB rate.
